title: Micron FY2026 Q3 earnings release
canonical_summary: Micron reported record FY2026 Q3 revenue and issued higher FY2026 Q4 guidance amid tight memory supply.
known_event_summary: On Jun. 24, Micron reported FY2026 Q3 revenue of $41.46B; guided FY2026 Q4 revenue to about $50B; said memory supply would remain tight beyond 2027; and disclosed 16 strategic customer agreements with $22B of projected deposits and related commitments.

facts.proposition: Micron reported FY2026 Q3 revenue of $41.46 billion.
Micron guided FY2026 Q4 revenue to approximately $50 billion.
Micron said memory supply would remain tight beyond 2027.
Micron disclosed 16 strategic customer agreements with $22 billion of projected deposits and related commitments.
